findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: There is a large quantity of what appear to be roach droppings along the wall under the dry storage shelves. There are also observed a few roaches on the multiple glue traps present in the dry storage. A spot check is being issued to observe the eradication of these pests with the expectation of increased glue trap presence and droppings cleaned up in addition to any other potential preventative measure provided by the school.
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The ceiling in the dry storage was observed to be chipping paint. A work order is going to be placed with the expectation by the inspection in the fall this task will be complete. Ensure ceilings are not chipping paint that could contaminate the food and make the ceiling smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.16: Observed caulking at the hand washing sink and the triple sink to be in need of repair. Ensure this seal is repaired to allow the surface to be smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable.
6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Milk cooler has a milk odor. Clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed knives and scoop to be on the shelf liner of the drawer which is soiled with dust and crumbs. This is not considered a clean or cleansable surface. Store clean utensils protected per our discussion.  750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed a cardboard box to be used in the kitchen to hold lids. The box was discarded and the lids cleaned.  Provide proper material for storage containers. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.510 - Employee was observed washing hands without proper technique. Barrier was not used to shut off the manual faucet. Proper handwashing technique was discussed with employee and manager.

Employees shall proper wash hands prior to putting on gloves, between glove changes, and prior to working with food, clean equipment, and unwrapped single service articles. Use paper towels to dry hands and then as a barrier to shut off the faucet to avoid re-contamination of freshly washed hands.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text:
750.120 - Commercially processed, individual packets of dressing were observed in direct contact with cleaned/portioned servings of salad. Staff were advised to change practice and place ranch packets in a separate container for persons to grab as they go through the lunch line. The outer surface of the ranch packets is not considered a clean surface.
Remaining portions of salad were prepared without dressing inside the bag used to cover portions. 

Foods shall be properly stored and protected from potential contamination at all times.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750.830g - Test strips appeared to have water damage and were not registering sanitizer concentration. Test strips were discarded. Manager will get some spare test strips from Jefferson Middle School until new set of quat strips are delivered on Wednesday.

A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.
200ppm quat = sanitizing concentration during ware washing

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text:
750.810 - Sanitizer solution for wiping general surfaces was at 0ppm quat. Solution was remade to be at proper concentration (200-400ppm).

Change out sanitizer solution every 2 to 4 hours or more often if wiping cloths and/or solution becomes heavily soiled. Maintain solution at concentration of 200-400ppm.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
750.810c - Solution used to wipe down cafeteria tables contained only soapy water. Staff were advised a quat solution (200ppm) needs to be utilized when wiping down tables to ensure proper sanitizing. If soapy solution is used the tables must then be wiped with plain water and then sanitizer solution.
Wet wiping cloths used for cleaning non-food contact surfaces such as counters, dining top tables, and shelves, shall be cleaned and rinsed frequently in an approved sanitizing solution and used only for non-food contact surfaces. Wiping cloths shall be stored in solution between uses.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) (R) Blue cart in storage room had tape wrapped around the handles for the top shelf, and a large gap was observed in the middle shelf. Kitchen manager stated she would be ordering a new cart soon. The cart was removed from the storage area during the inspection. B) (R) Brown cart in storage area had a burn mark at one of the top corners. Kitchen manager was advised to use caulk or silicone to smooth out gaps/crevices. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The lower shelves of prep tables had some accumulation of crumbs/debris. Clean the lower shelves of prep tables daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text: 750.880 - Plastic utensils observed with food surfaces and handles intermixed in storage baskets. Store utensils with handles all facing one direction so food surfaces will not be touched when persons retrieve them. Single-service articles shall be stored, handled, and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user. Single-service knives, forks and spoons packaged in bulk shall be inserted into holders to protect these items from contamination and stored with handles extended unless the utensils are pre-wrapped or pre-packaged.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text: 750.1060 - (R) Leak was observed at base of the right faucet at the 3 part sink when hot and cold water handles were turned on. Repair the faucet so it does not leak. All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.comment: Observed the wood cabinet ,used as a serving counter, the bottom shelf to be peeling and chipping paint . Section 750.690 Make surface smooth and easily cleanable.
